name: Standing Order Processing SOP
description: The end-to-end operational procedure for processing standing orders within FirstUK Bank, managed by the Head of Operations for the Retail Banking department.
context: FirstUK Bank — Standing Order Processing SOP

name: Head of Operations
description: The designated owner of the Standing Order Processing SOP, responsible for the document's oversight and governance.

name: Operations Staff
description: Personnel within the Operations department designated as a primary audience for the standing order processing procedures.
context: Audience | Operations Staff, Branch Staff, Customer Service

name: Branch Staff
description: Personnel within the bank branches designated as a primary audience for the standing order processing procedures.
context: Audience | Operations Staff, Branch Staff, Customer Service

name: Customer Service
description: Personnel within the customer service function designated as a primary audience for the standing order processing procedures.
context: Audience | Operations Staff, Branch Staff, Customer Service

name: Standing Order Management Process
description: A standardized operational workflow for the end-to-end lifecycle of standing orders, encompassing their setup, maintenance, modification, and cancellation to ensure accurate and timely recurring transfers.
context: Establish standardized procedures for setting up, maintaining, modifying, and canceling standing orders
ensure accurate, timely execution of customer-initiated recurring transfers

name: Standing Order Management Process
description: An end-to-end operational procedure covering the creation, modification, cancellation, and failure handling of standing orders. This process is applicable across all banking channels including online, branch, and phone.

name: Standing Order Setup Process
description: The end-to-end operational workflow for establishing a new standing order, starting from the initial customer request through to system execution and failure monitoring.

name: Collect Standing Order Details
description: The initial action of gathering the necessary payment and beneficiary details required to establish a standing order.

name: Validate Standing Order Information
description: A review stage where the collected standing order details are checked for accuracy and completeness before system entry.

name: System Setup in AMS/PPS
description: The technical recording of the standing order into the bank's core systems, specifically identified as AMS or PPS.

name: Customer Confirmation
description: The final step of the setup phase where the bank confirms the activation of the standing order to the customer.

name: Scheduled Execution
description: The automated stage where the system processes the payment on the pre-defined schedule.

name: Payment Failure Monitoring
description: The ongoing operational oversight to identify and handle any failures in the execution of the standing order.

name: Customer
description: The bank customer who initiates the request for a standing order and receives confirmation of its activation.

name: AMS/PPS System
description: The automated banking systems used to record the standing order and execute the scheduled payments.

name: Standing Order
description: The financial instruction being created, validated, and executed as part of this procedure.

name: Customer Request Submission
description: The initial stage where a customer initiates a request through one of four supported channels: online banking portal, phone, branch visit, or mail.
context: Online: Self-service via online banking portal
Mail: Send request with account details

name: Customer
description: The individual initiating the request via online, phone, branch, or mail channels.

name: Branch Staff Member
description: The bank employee responsible for receiving and processing requests submitted in person at a branch location.

name: Standing Order Setup Process
description: The operational procedure for collecting and recording the necessary details to establish a fixed-amount recurring payment from a source account to a designated payee.

name: Initial Information Collection Step
description: The primary stage of the process where critical payment parameters including account numbers, payee details, amount, and frequency are gathered from the customer.

name: Source Account
description: The customer account from which the standing order funds will be debited.

name: Standing Order Mandate
description: A recurring payment instruction characterized by a fixed amount and a defined frequency (weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annual).

name: Standing Order Setup Process
description: The operational workflow for validating and establishing a standing order, including source account verification, payee information checks, and payment frequency validation.
context: If Validation Fails: Contact customer for correction

name: Validate Request Details
description: A discrete stage where the source account, payee information, and payment amount/frequency are verified against specific criteria to ensure the request is valid.

name: Bank Staff Member
description: The actor responsible for performing validation checks and contacting the customer if details are incorrect.

name: Validation Outcome Gate
description: A branching point where the process either proceeds if all validation checks are passed or triggers a correction cycle if any check fails.

name: Customer Correction Cycle
description: The remedial action taken when validation fails, involving contacting the customer to clarify and collect correct information before re-validating.

name: Requesting Customer
description: The bank customer who is requesting the setup of a standing order and whose account is being validated as the source of funds.

name: Source Account
description: The account from which funds will be drawn, which must be active, match the requestor, and contain sufficient funds for the first payment.
context: Account has sufficient funds (for first payment)

name: Standing Order Instruction
description: The specific payment instruction being validated, encompassing the payee's account details, the amount, the frequency, and the start date.

name: Standing Order Setup Process
description: The operational workflow for creating a standing order within the bank's internal systems. This process involves entering specific financial and recipient data into the AMS/PPS systems to enable recurring payments.

name: Standing Order Data Entry in AMS/PPS
description: The discrete action of entering standing order details into the AMS/PPS system. This includes the input of source accounts, payee details, amounts, frequency, and effective dates.

name: Bank Staff Member
description: The internal bank employee responsible for the actual system entry and setup of the standing order, identified in the system by their Staff ID.
context: Created By | Staff ID | Who set it up

name: Customer Source Account
description: The customer's bank account from which the recurring standing order funds will be debited.

name: Standing Order Instruction
description: The specific recurring payment instruction created in the system, characterized by an auto-generated ID, a fixed amount, and a recurrence pattern.

name: AMS/PPS System
description: The banking system used for the creation and management of standing orders, responsible for auto-generating Standing Order IDs.

name: Standing Order Frequency Scheduling Process
description: The operational procedure for defining and executing the timing of recurring transfers based on specific calendar intervals. It governs how payments are triggered on a monthly, weekly, quarterly, or annual basis.
context: Executes on same calendar day each month

name: Monthly Frequency Execution
description: The process of executing a transfer on the same calendar day of each month. This is a recurring action that continues until an end date is reached.
context: Monthly: Executes on same calendar day each month

name: Weekly Frequency Execution
description: The process of executing a transfer every 7 days.

name: Quarterly Frequency Execution
description: The process of executing a transfer every 3 months.

name: Annual Frequency Execution
description: The process of executing a transfer once per year.

name: Recurring Standing Order Transfer
description: A financial event involving a fixed sum (e.g., £500) transferred at regular intervals as defined by the frequency schedule.

name: Standing Order Setup Process
description: The operational workflow for establishing a standing order, including the final stage of confirming the setup details with the customer across multiple channels.
context: Confirmation that standing order is active

name: Customer Confirmation Step
description: The final stage of the standing order setup where the bank provides specific transaction details to the customer via their preferred communication channel to confirm activation.

name: Customer
description: The individual receiving confirmation of their standing order setup via email, SMS, phone, or in-branch receipt.

name: Standing Order
description: The financial instruction being activated, identified by a Standing order ID and containing payee details, amount, frequency, and start date.
context: Confirmation that standing order is active

name: Standing Order Execution Process
description: The end-to-end workflow for executing scheduled standing order payments. It involves automated identification, fund validation, transfer via FPS, and ledger recording, occurring in the early morning before business hours.
context: Processing occurs early morning (before business hours)
Funds transferred via FPS (Faster Payments Service)

name: Standing Order Identification Step
description: The initial automated action where the system identifies all standing orders that are due for execution on the scheduled date.

name: Source Account Fund Validation Step
description: A verification step to ensure the source account possesses sufficient funds to cover the standing order payment before the transfer is initiated.
context: Validates source account has sufficient funds

name: FPS Transfer Initiation Step
description: The execution of the fund transfer using the Faster Payments Service (FPS), ensuring the recipient receives funds within 1 hour.
context: Recipient account receives funds within 1 hour

name: Ledger Transaction Recording Step
description: The process of recording the completed financial transaction within the bank's ledger for audit and balance tracking.

name: Standing Order Status Update Step
description: Updating the internal status of the specific standing order to 'completed' following a successful transfer.

name: Customer Notification Step
description: An optional step to notify the customer of the transaction, triggered only if the customer has opted into notifications.

name: Standing Order Automated System
description: The automated banking system responsible for identifying due payments, validating funds, initiating FPS transfers, and updating ledgers.
context: Validates source account has sufficient funds

name: Operations Staff
description: Personnel responsible for manual intervention in the event of persistent standing order failures.

name: Funds Availability Check
description: A branching point determining if a transfer proceeds or fails. If funds are sufficient, the transfer is initiated; if unavailable, the transfer is declined and a retry is attempted.

name: Standing Order Customer
description: The bank customer who has set up a standing order and is the subject of notifications regarding success or failure of the payment.

name: Scheduled Standing Order
description: The specific standing order instruction being executed on its scheduled date (e.g., 15th of the month).
context: Standing order executes on scheduled date (e.g., 15th of month)

name: FPS Standing Order Transaction
description: The financial event of transferring funds via the Faster Payments Service as part of the standing order execution.
context: Funds transferred via FPS (Faster Payments Service)

name: Standing Order Modification Process
description: The operational procedure for updating the details of an existing standing order. It defines the specific fields a customer is permitted to modify and the system logic triggered by those changes.

name: Modify Standing Order Amount
description: The action of changing the payment amount of a standing order. This specific modification triggers the creation of a new standing order and the cancellation of the old one.
context: Amount: Change payment amount (creates new SO, cancels old)

name: Modify Standing Order Frequency
description: The action of changing the timing of the standing order payments, such as moving from a weekly to a monthly cadence.

name: Modify Standing Order Payee
description: The action of changing the recipient of the standing order. Similar to amount changes, this requires the creation of a new standing order and the cancellation of the existing one.
context: Payee: Change recipient (creates new SO, cancels old)

name: Modify Standing Order End Date
description: The action of setting or changing the end date for the standing order payments.
context: End Date: Set or change end date

name: Customer
description: The bank customer who initiates the modification of their standing order details.

name: Standing Order
description: The recurring payment instruction being modified, which may be cancelled and replaced depending on the type of change requested.

name: Standing Order Modification Process
description: The end-to-end procedure for amending existing standing orders via online banking or through branch and phone channels. It includes paths for simple field updates and full changes requiring replacement.

name: Customer
description: The bank customer who initiates the modification of a standing order either through self-service online banking or by contacting the bank via phone or branch visit.

name: Branch Staff
description: The bank employee responsible for updating the system records when a customer requests a standing order modification via phone or in-person visit.

name: Online Banking Login
description: The initial step of the online modification path where the customer authenticates into their online banking account.

name: Standing Order Selection
description: The step where the customer identifies and selects the specific standing order they wish to modify from their account list.

name: Field Modification
description: The action where the customer enters the new values for the desired fields of the standing order.

name: Modification Confirmation
description: The final customer action to commit the changes to the standing order.

name: Online Confirmation Receipt
description: The system-generated notification sent to the customer confirming the online modification was successful.

name: Channel Contact Initiation
description: The initial step for non-digital modifications where the customer contacts the bank via phone or visits a physical branch.

name: Standing Order Identification
description: The step where the customer provides the standing order ID and current details to the staff member for verification.
context: Provides standing order ID and current details

name: Change Specification
description: The step where the customer explicitly states the changes they wish to apply to the standing order.

name: System Record Update
description: The action performed by the staff member to update the standing order details within the bank's internal systems.

name: Staff-Initiated Confirmation
description: The final step where the staff member ensures a confirmation of the change is sent to the customer.

name: Modification Scope Check
description: A decision point to determine if the requested changes are simple field updates or 'full changes' (amount, payee, frequency). Full changes trigger a different workflow: cancellation of the old SO and creation of a new one.
context: Full changes (amount, payee, frequency) may require cancellation of old SO and creation of new SO

name: Standing Order Cancellation Process
description: The end-to-end procedure for cancelling a standing order, encompassing multiple request channels (Online, Phone, Branch, Mail) and the collection of specific mandate details.

name: Standing Order Cancellation Request
description: The initial stage where a customer initiates the request to cancel a standing order through an approved channel and provides necessary identification details.
context: How to Request: Online: Self-service cancellation in portal, Phone: Call 0800-555-2265, Branch: Visit and request cancellation, Mail: Send written cancellation request

name: Customer
description: The account holder responsible for initiating the cancellation request via the online portal, telephone, branch visit, or mail.

name: Online Portal System
description: The automated system used by customers for self-service cancellation of standing orders.

name: Standing Order
description: The specific financial instruction being cancelled, identified by a Standing order ID, Payee name, Amount, and Account number.

name: Standing Order Cancellation Process
description: The operational workflow for cancelling a customer's standing order. The process is free of charge, requires no notice period, and takes effect immediately.
context: No Notice Required: Customer can cancel anytime with no notice

name: Cancellation Request Receipt
description: The initial stage of the process where the customer formally requests the cancellation of their standing order.

name: Customer Identity Verification
description: A security step where staff must verify the identity of the customer making the request before proceeding with the cancellation.

name: Standing Order Confirmation
description: The step where the specific standing order to be cancelled is identified and confirmed.

name: Account Status Update
description: The administrative action of updating the standing order status to 'Cancelled' within the bank's systems.

name: Effective Date Application
description: The application of the cancellation date, which is processed immediately without a notice period.

name: Payment Blockage
description: The operational action to ensure that the next scheduled payment associated with the standing order is blocked.

name: Customer Cancellation Notification
description: The final step where a confirmation of the cancellation is communicated to the customer.

name: Bank Staff
description: The internal bank personnel responsible for verifying customer identity and executing the standing order cancellation steps.

name: Customer
description: The bank customer who initiates the cancellation request and receives the final confirmation.

name: Target Standing Order
description: The specific standing order payment instruction being cancelled by the customer.

name: Standing Order Cancellation Process
description: The operational workflow for confirming the cancellation of a standing order, ensuring the customer is notified of the specific order ID and the termination of future payments.
context: Customer Receives: Email confirmation of cancellation

name: Cancellation Confirmation Notification
description: The final stage of the cancellation process where a confirmation email is dispatched to the customer containing the canceled standing order ID, the date of cancellation, and a guarantee that no further payments will occur.
context: Customer Receives: Email confirmation of cancellation
Confirmation that no further payments will be made

name: Customer
description: The recipient of the cancellation confirmation and the subject of the standing order cancellation process.

name: Canceled Standing Order
description: The specific financial instruction being terminated, identified by a unique standing order ID.
context: Standing order ID that was canceled

name: Standing Order Failure Handling Process
description: The operational procedure for identifying and managing standing orders that fail to execute. It encompasses the identification of common failure scenarios such as insufficient funds or invalid account details.

name: Standing Order Failure Analysis
description: The stage in the process where the reason for a failed standing order is identified. This involves checking for source account funds, recipient account validity, and system failures.

name: Source Account
description: The customer account from which the standing order funds are being drawn, subject to insufficient funds checks during failure analysis.

name: Recipient Account
description: The destination account for the standing order payment, which may cause failure if the account number is invalid or the account is closed.

name: Failed Standing Order Transaction
description: A financial event where a standing order payment has failed to complete due to specific operational or financial triggers.

name: Standing Order Payment
description: The recurring payment instruction being processed, which is subject to failure scenarios such as payee bank system errors.

name: Standing Order Failure Handling Process
description: An operational workflow designed to detect, alert, and resolve failed standing order attempts. The process involves automated system actions, customer notifications, a single retry attempt, and manual staff intervention for resolution.
context: System logs failed standing order attempt
If retry fails: Standing order suspended

name: Failure Detection Step
description: The initial phase where the system identifies a failed standing order attempt and updates the record status to 'Failed' within the system logs.
context: System logs failed standing order attempt

name: Customer Alerting Step
description: An automated communication step where the customer is notified via Email or SMS regarding the failure, including details of the amount, recipient, and reason, with a request for corrective action.
context: Alert includes: Amount, recipient, failure reason

name: Automated Retry Attempt Step
description: A system-driven attempt to re-process the standing order, typically occurring within a 24-hour window. A successful retry allows the standing order to resume normally.
context: If retry successful: Standing order resumes

name: Retry Success Determination
description: A branching point based on the outcome of the system retry. If successful, the process concludes with the order resuming; if it fails, the process escalates to manual staff review.
context: If retry successful: Standing order resumes
If retry fails: Standing order suspended

name: Escalation and Review Step
description: A manual intervention stage triggered by a failed retry where the standing order is suspended and staff members must review the case and contact the customer.

name: Resolution and Update Step
description: The final stage where staff update the standing order based on corrected information provided by the customer, leading to either the resumption of the order or its cancellation.
context: Standing order resumes or customer opts for cancellation

name: Automated Banking System
description: The system responsible for logging failures, updating order statuses, sending automated alerts, and executing the 24-hour retry attempt.
context: System logs failed standing order attempt

name: Bank Staff
description: Human personnel responsible for reviewing suspended standing orders, contacting customers for resolution, and manually updating order details in the system.

name: Customer
description: The recipient of failure alerts who is required to provide funds, update payee information, or opt for cancellation to resolve the failure.
context: Request for action (provide funds, update payee)

name: Failed Standing Order
description: The specific payment instruction that has failed its execution attempt and is subject to detection, retry, suspension, or cancellation.

name: Weekly Standing Order Review
description: A weekly operational monitoring and control procedure designed to review executed standing orders, identify failures or unusual patterns, and ensure reconciliation of payments.

name: Operations Staff
description: Staff members responsible for performing the weekly review of standing order values, failure counts, and pattern analysis.

name: Standing Order Operational Review
description: A review step where Operations Staff analyze the total value of executed standing orders, the number of failures, unusual patterns such as large amounts or unusual recipients, and related customer complaints.
context: Total value of standing orders executed
Customer complaints related to standing orders

name: Standing Order Reconciliation
description: A verification step to ensure standing order transactions match customer expectations, confirm the absence of duplicate payments, and verify that all payments were executed on scheduled dates.
context: Standing order transactions match customer expectations

name: Standing Order Transaction
description: The financial instructions being reviewed and reconciled weekly to ensure correct execution and value.
context: Total value of standing orders executed
Standing order transactions match customer expectations

name: Standing Order Audit Trail Management
description: The procedure for maintaining system records of standing orders, including creation, modification, cancellation, and execution history. Records are retained for 6 years in accordance with POCA regulations.
context: Retention: Retained for 6 years (per POCA regulations)

name: Standing Order System Recording
description: The action of capturing and storing all standing order lifecycle events, including active and canceled orders, creation dates, staff identifiers, modifications, and execution outcomes.
context: Creation date and staff who created

name: POCA Data Retention Checkpoint
description: A regulatory compliance gate ensuring that all standing order records are retained for the mandatory period of 6 years as required by the Proceeds of Crime Act (POCA).
context: Retention: Retained for 6 years (per POCA regulations)

name: Standing Order Processing Staff
description: The bank staff member responsible for the creation of standing orders, whose identity must be recorded in the system audit trail.

name: Standing Order Quality Assurance Process
description: A quality assurance procedure consisting of a pre-activation checklist and a monthly audit to ensure the accuracy and validity of standing order setups and executions.

name: Standing Order Pre-Activation Verification
description: A mandatory review performed before a standing order is activated to verify source accounts, payee details, amounts, frequencies, dates, and customer confirmation.

name: Standing Order Monthly Audit
description: A recurring monthly review of at least 10 standing orders to ensure correct execution dates, transfer amounts, recipient delivery, and customer satisfaction.

name: Standing Order Activation Gate
description: A decision point where a standing order is only activated if all checklist items—including account verification, payee validity, and customer confirmation—are satisfied.

name: Standing Order Data Integrity Check
description: A formal control point ensuring that the financial details of a standing order (sort code, account format, and amount > £0) meet bank operational standards before activation.
context: Payee information valid (account/sort code format correct)

name: Quality Assurance Auditor
description: The actor responsible for performing the pre-activation checklist and conducting the monthly audit of 10+ standing orders.

name: Standing Order Customer
description: The bank customer who provides confirmation for the standing order and whose satisfaction is monitored during the monthly audit.

name: Standing Order Instruction
description: The specific payment instruction being verified for activation and audited for execution accuracy.

name: Account Opening Process
description: The end-to-end procedure for opening a new bank account, which includes the availability of standing order setup as part of the workflow.

name: Standing Order Setup Process
description: A specific operational workflow available during the account opening process to establish recurring payment instructions.

name: Payment Processing System
description: The automated system responsible for the technical execution of standing orders.

name: Head of Operations
description: A senior leadership role responsible for the formal approval and sign-off of the operational procedure document.
context: Approved by: Head of Operations — Date: 2026-01-15

name: Head of Retail Banking
description: A senior leadership role responsible for the formal approval and sign-off of the operational procedure document.
